Place a container under the vehicle to collect the engine coolant.

1. Open collar (1a) and disconnect lower radiator hose (1b) to drain the engine coolant into the underlying container.

2. Open collar (2a) and disconnect upper hose (2b) from the radiator to drain the engine coolant into the underlying container.

3. Undo the bolts securing the radiator to the crossmember.

4. Remove the radiator from the upper part of the car by releasing from the lower retaining blocks.
